sources.notes: Original company fact book used retrospectively for dated milestones: 1984 leadership, 1987 store, 1989 Disney-MGM Studios, 1992 Euro Disney, 1994 Lion King and Paris refinancing, and February 1996 completion of the ABC acquisition. Only in-window milestones are used; the publication day is not established.

Original annual report, publication day not established. Net income was $4.178 billion in 1995; services revenue rose from $9.715 billion to $12.714 billion; Lotus was acquired July 5, 1995. Indexed report text consulted. Some windows end before the report was published; only the earlier business events and fiscal results are described.

Original filing: fiscal 1991 sales $32.602 billion versus fiscal 1996 $93.627 billion; domestic supercenters grew from 9 to 239. Fiscal 1996 sales grew 13%, net income only 2.2%. Fiscal years end January 31. For February 1996 endpoint, this is retrospective documentation of the year already completed, not an in-window filing.
